g.text: PROPERTY LINES ARE DRAWN FROM THE RECORDED PLAT. NO FIELD
SURVEY WAS MADE FOR THIS PLAN.

LOCATE ALL UNDERGROUND UTILITIES BEFORE DIGGING.

STREET. KEEP RUNOFF OFF THE ADJOINING LOTS.
PUT EROSION CONTROL IN PLACE BEFORE CLEARING, AND KEEP IT UNTIL
PROTECT THE EXISTING TREES SHOWN. NO TREE IS TO BE REMOVED.
